# SIP Guardian — llms.txt

## Project Name
**SIP Guardian** — AI-Powered Street Safety Device Network

## Purpose
SIP Guardian is an edge-AI threat detection and safety response system. It uses a distributed mesh of Raspberry Pi edge nodes running local object detection models to identify threats (weapons, suspicious behavior, violence, animals) on city streets, alert operators via a mobile app, and autonomously trigger deterrence responses (sirens, lights).

**Status: research prototype / beta.** Not a certified emergency service. Not yet production-validated for life-safety use.

## Architecture

### Edge Nodes (Raspberry Pi)
- Run local YOLO/SSD inference — no cloud round-trip for detection
- Publish incidents via MQTT (QoS 1) to a broker → backend
- REST fallback when MQTT is unavailable
- SQLite offline queue for incidents when both paths fail
- Autonomous deterrence (siren, strobe) via GPIO even when fully offline
- Heartbeat reporting to backend

### Backend (Spring Boot + Neon PostgreSQL)
- REST API at `https://api.sip.bchbenjamin.in/`
- WebSocket for real-time operator notifications
- MQTT broker integration for bidirectional Pi communication
- Flyway migrations for schema management
- JWT authentication for operators

### Android App (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose)
- Operator dashboard with live incident feed
- Push notifications via WebSocket
- Local Room cache for offline viewing
- Biometric / PIN unlock

### Landing Page (React + TanStack Start)
- Public marketing site at `https://sip.bchbenjamin.in/`
- Built with TanStack Start + Vite, deployed on Vercel

## Key Links
- **Repository:** https://github.com/bchbenjamin/SIP

- **Android APK (beta):** See GitHub Releases

## Threat Detection Capabilities
- Weapon detection (knife, gun, visual threat signatures)
- Suspicious behavior detection
- Violence detection
- Animal detection (dogs, bears — potential threats)
- Audio anomaly detection (sirens, gunshots)

## Limitations
- Detection accuracy depends on camera angle, lighting, and model weights
- No integration with real police or emergency services
- Beta software — expect bugs, false positives, and missed detections
- Do not use as a substitute for professional security or emergency response
